CatchUp Universal 🚀

You've reached the deployment page for the CatchUp Chrome Extension!
CatchUp is a browser extension, not a website. It runs locally in your browser to summarize your Slack, WhatsApp, and Teams messages privately using AI.

Attention Evaluators: To test this project, please clone the GitHub repository and load it into Chrome via chrome://extensions (Developer Mode). It cannot be run as a standard webpage.
